[
  {
    "i": 0,
    "architecture": "tandem_2T",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": null,
    "pce_certified": {"value": 34.85, "unit": "%", "anchor": "certified power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) reaching 34.85%"},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Perovskite/Si tandem solar cells have achieved certified PCEs of 34.85%, surpassing single-junction Si limits.", "anchor": "certified power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) reaching 34.85%, highlighting their strong potential to surpass the efficiency limits of conventional single‐junction Si devices", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Deposition methods for perovskite films, CTLs, electrodes, ICLs, and encapsulation are summarized for perovskite/Si TSCs.", "anchor": "This review paper summarizes the deposition methods used to fabricate perovskite films, carrier transport layers (CTLs), and electrodes for the top perovskite cell of perovskite/Si TSCs.", "evidence_type": "inference"},
      {"text": "A cost comparison between solution-processed and vacuum-based deposition methods is presented.", "anchor": "a cost comparison between solution‐processed and vacuum‐based methods is presented", "evidence_type": "inference"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 1,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "(TFBZ)PbI3/3D",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.54, "unit": "%", "anchor": "achieve a power conversion efficiency of 25.54%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "TFBZ-based 1D/3D hybrid PSCs achieve 25.54% PCE with operational and thermal stability.", "anchor": "the resulting TFBZ‐based 1D/3D hybrid PSCs achieve a power conversion efficiency of 25.54%, while maintaining expectational operational and thermal stability", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Trifluoromethyl groups in TFBZ contribute to extensive hydrogen-bond networks and high dipole moment, strengthening interaction with [PbI6]4− skeleton.", "anchor": "the trifluoromethyl groups in TFBZ contribute to extensive hydrogen‐bond networks and confer a high dipole moment", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Incorporation of 1D (TFBZ)PbI3 forms a robust 1D/3D heterojunction via stable 1D phase, favorable lattice matching, strong interface binding, and effective defect passivation.", "anchor": "the incorporation of 1D (TFBZ)PbI 3 forms a robust and high‐quality 1D/3D heterojunction interface, facilitated by stable 1D phase, favorable lattice matching, strong interface binding, and effective defect passivation", "evidence_type": "inference"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 2,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 21.65, "unit": "%", "anchor": "achieving 21.65% under 1 sun illumination"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "MQPPO cathode interlayer improves energy level alignment, charge extraction, and interfacial stability in p-i-n PSCs.", "anchor": "MQPPO improves energy level alignment, charge extraction, and interfacial stability through its strong dipole moment and hydrophobic properties", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "MQPPO-based PSCs achieve 21.65% PCE under 1 sun illumination.", "anchor": "achieving 21.65% under 1 sun illumination", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "MQPPO-based PSCs maintain over 80% of initial efficiency after 1440 h.", "anchor": "maintaining over 80% of their initial efficiency after 1440 h", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 3,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.29, "unit": "%", "anchor": "set a new benchmark with an efficiency of 25.29%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "PSCs incorporating perfluorophenyl-substituted TPE 1 (TFP-TPE) as interlayer achieve 25.29% efficiency.", "anchor": "PSCs incorporating 1 set a new benchmark with an efficiency of 25.29%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Fluorinated TPE materials inhibit molecular aggregation, enhance surface wettability, and form strong bonds with perovskite precursors.", "anchor": "These fluorinated materials effectively inhibit molecular aggregation, enhance surface wettability, and form strong bonds with perovskite precursors", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Unencapsulated devices with TFP-TPE exhibit exceptional stability under humid conditions and elevated temperatures.", "anchor": "unencapsulated devices incorporating 1 exhibit exceptional stability under humid conditions and elevated temperatures", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 4,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 22.2, "unit": "%", "anchor": "power conversion efficiencies of 22.2% (≈0.12 cm 2 minicells)"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 1.41, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "active area: 1.41 cm 2"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "TEA-TFSI spontaneous passivator with dual functional groups passivates both A-site and X-site defects via ammonium and thiophene moieties.", "anchor": "TEA cations are adsorbed at both A ‐ and X ‐site defects via ammonium and thiophene moieties, respectively, overcoming the single‐site limitation of RA‐TFSIs", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "PSCs with TEA-TFSI achieve 22.2% on minicells and 21.7% on minimodules (active area 1.41 cm2).", "anchor": "power conversion efficiencies of 22.2% (≈0.12 cm 2 minicells) and 21.7% (≈1.6 cm 2 minimodules, active area: 1.41 cm 2 ), respectively", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Spontaneous passivation using TEA-TFSI forms a monolayer-like overlayer and improves PTAA adhesion.", "anchor": "Spontaneous passivation using TEA‐TFSI forms a monolayer‐like overlayer", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 5,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.92, "unit": "%", "anchor": "champion power conversion efficiency of 25.92%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "TFMP-treated spiro-OMeTAD PSCs achieve 25.92% champion PCE.", "anchor": "PSCs incorporating TFMP achieve a champion power conversion efficiency of 25.92%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Under continuous MPPT at 1-sun illumination, TFMP-treated devices retained over 91% of initial efficiency after 1000 h.", "anchor": "under continuous maximum power point tracking (MPPT) at 1‐sun illumination, TFMP‐treated devices retained over 91% of their initial efficiency after 1000 h", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "TFMP promotes ion-pair dissociation through electrostatic interactions with TFSI−, increasing free TFSI− availability for efficient doping.", "anchor": "the electron‐withdrawing TFMP promotes ion‐pair dissociation through electrostatic interactions with TFSI − , increasing the availability of free TFSI − required for efficient doping", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 6,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 23.5, "unit": "%", "anchor": "achieving a champion power conversion efficiency of 23.5%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 1.0, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "retaining 20.6% at 1.0 cm 2"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "PDVB14 as HTL achieves 23.5% champion PCE and retains 20.6% at 1.0 cm2.", "anchor": "achieving a champion power conversion efficiency of 23.5% and retaining 20.6% at 1.0 cm 2", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "DVB incorporation increases backbone planarity and stabilizes electronic structure by promoting delocalized radical-cation states.", "anchor": "DVB incorporation increases backbone planarity and stabilizes the electronic structure by promoting more delocalized radical‐cation states", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Highly uniform Li profiles across 6 × 6 cm2 films demonstrate compatibility with large-area solution processing.", "anchor": "Dopant‐distribution mapping reveals highly uniform Li profiles across 6 × 6 cm 2 films, demonstrating excellent compatibility with large‐area solution processing", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 7,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": null,
    "pce_certified": {"value": 26.35, "unit": "%", "anchor": "deliver a certified power conversion efficiency of 26.35%"},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Multidentate phosphonic acid anchoring PSCs deliver 26.35% certified PCE.", "anchor": "deliver a certified power conversion efficiency of 26.35%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retain 82% after 1000 h thermal stability test at 85°C and 86% after 1000 h MPPT.", "anchor": "retaining 82% of their initial performance after 1000 h of thermal stability test (85°C) and 86% after 1000 h of maximum power point tracking", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Tripodal phosphonic acid molecules segregate to perovskite grain boundaries for coordinative passivation of undercoordinated Pb2+ defects.", "anchor": "these molecules segregate preferentially to perovskite grain boundaries, where they engage in coordinative passivation of undercoordinated Pb 2 + defects", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 8,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.73, "unit": "%", "anchor": "achieved a remarkable power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.73%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": "ISOS-T-3",
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "MeS-BPADCP SAM-based inverted PSCs achieve 26.73% PCE.", "anchor": "the MeS‐BPADCP based device achieved a remarkable power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.73%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices sustain 94.2% of initial efficiency after 1000 h continuous one-sun operation.", "anchor": "sustaining 94.2% of its initial efficiency after continuous operation under one‐sun illumination for 1000 h", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retain 93.3% of initial PCE after 240 thermal cycles between −40°C and 85°C (ISOS-T-3).", "anchor": "retaining 93.3% of its initial PCE after 240 cycles within a temperature range of −40°C to 85°C (ISOS‐T‐3 protocol)", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 9,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "((FA0.95Cs0.05)PbI3)0.975(MAPbBr3)0.025",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.53, "unit": "%", "anchor": "boosted the device PCE from 23.55% to 25.53%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Au12Ag30 nanocluster at 0.5 mg/mL boosts device PCE from 23.55% to 25.53%.", "anchor": "Introducing 0.5 mg/mL of this cluster into ((FA 0.95 Cs 0.05 )PbI 3 ) 0.975 (MAPbBr 3 ) 0.025 perovskite films boosted the device PCE from 23.55% to 25.53%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices enable 94.8% PCE retention after 1142 h continuous one-sun illumination.", "anchor": "enables 94.8% retention after 1142 h of continuous one‐sun illumination", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Au12Ag30 has a −6 superatomic charge and 66.7% surface halogen coverage, the highest ever reported.", "anchor": "Au 12 Ag 30 is also distinguished by its −6 superatomic charge, and 66.7% surface halogen coverage—the highest ever reported", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 10,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.57, "unit": "%", "anchor": "champion power conversion efficiencies of 25.57% for 0.09 cm 2"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Ambient-printed devices achieve 25.57% for 0.09 cm2, 23.98% for 1.04 cm2, and 22.98% in 5×5 cm2 mini-modules.", "anchor": "ambient‐printed devices achieve champion power conversion efficiencies of 25.57% for 0.09 cm 2 , 23.98% for 1.04 cm 2 , and 22.98% in 5 × 5 cm 2 mini‐modules", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Aromatic formamidine ligands form simultaneous coordination bonds with [PbI6]4− octahedra and hydrogen bonds with FA+ ions.", "anchor": "ligands to form simultaneous coordination bonds with [PbI 6 ] 4— octahedra and hydrogen bonds with formamidinium ions (FA + )", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Optimized devices retain over 90% of initial performance after 1000 h continuous operation.", "anchor": "The optimized devices retain over 90% of their initial performance after 1,000 h of continuous operation", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 11,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": null,
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "PyTPA-10C with even-carbon decyl chain serves as dopant-free HTM in n-i-p PSCs.", "anchor": "PyTPA-10C, featuring an even-carbon decyl chain as a dopant-free HTMs in n-i-p structured PSCs", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The odd-even effect of the alkyl spacer significantly modulates molecular conformation and electronic structure.", "anchor": "the odd-even effect of the alkyl spacer plays a significant role in modulating the molecular conformation and electronic structure", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Three pyrene-based HTMs display a pronounced antenna effect with positive correlation between TPA antenna moieties and photophysical parameters.", "anchor": "which display a pronounced antenna effect analogous to the precursor which is quantitatively defined by a positive correlation between the number of TPA antenna moieties and key photophysical parameters", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  }
]
